subject: prd/docgate
statement: When invoked as `check-links`, docgate shall resolve every relative markdown link target in `docs/**/*.md`, `AGENTS.md`, and the configured templates directory to an existing file — skipping fenced code blocks, external URLs, and pure `#fragment` links — and shall fail on any dangling target, naming source file, line, and target.
rationale: inbound links to frozen docs never go stale by design; outbound links rot silently when targets move, and nothing checked (#54 A5)
fit_criterion: a dangling-link fixture red naming file, line, and target; fenced-block, external, and fragment-only links ignored; the real corpus green
